{{nihongo|'''Minowa Shrine'''|箕匂神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Minewa, {{ill|Matsuzaki, Shizuoka|Q1204017|qid=Q1204017}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401133 Minowa Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Shrine Office</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Minowa Shrine'''|箕匂神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is located on the northern mountain foothills of the Minewa district in northeastern Matsuzaki.

It is identified as the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} Minowa "Mino" Shrine (???????), and is an ancient shrine also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no kuni jinjaich?|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "J?shi-i no J? Minowa no My?jin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/minosiro_title.htm Minowa Shrine] - Genmatsushi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140301-01.html Minowa Shrine] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

It was ranked as a village shrine in {{ill|Taishō era|Q329174|qid=Q329174}} 14 ({{ill|1925|Q18107|qid=Q18107}})<ref name="engi"/>.
